key_fields.colony_shape: sphere or close to a sphere

narrative.morphology: Colonies with many closely packed tiny (0.4-1.0 μm diameter) spherical cells with no gas vacuoles, irregularly arranged and embedded in mucilage with indistinct outer margin. Rare. Identified only to genus level.
narrative.ecology: Rare in Lake Kinneret, we have no ecological data for this genus.
